messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
Effects reported after a sertraline tablet overdose include seizures.
These seizures may be delayed.
Effects reported after a sertraline tablet overdose also include changes in mental state.
These changes include coma.
Heart effects can also be delayed.
They include changes in the electrical activity of the heart.
These changes involve QRS and QTc prolongation.
High blood pressure is seen most often.
Low blood pressure is rare.
Low blood pressure can happen when other substances are taken.
Alcohol is one of the substances that can cause low blood pressure.
Serotonin syndrome can occur.
The risk is higher when several drugs that raise serotonin have been taken together.

The relation 'can occur with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or effect may happen when the object entity is present or used concurrently.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'occurs if': The condition or event specified by the subject entity happens under the condition described in the object entity.
B. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
C. 'may appear in': A part of the subject entity may be present or appear in the entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'more common in': The subject condition or event occurs more frequently in the group or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
